feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: FBI investigating after hackers say they took sensitive data from agency's jobs site
entry.summary: The FBI is investigating criminal hackers' claims of breaching its jobs website. The apparent hack poses a potential counterintelligence risk and a safety concern for employees and applicants.

entry.title: What's at stake during the meeting between Trump and Xi
entry.summary: What can we expect from the Trump-Xi summit? NPR's A Martinez asks Daniel Kritenbrink, an assistant Secretary of State for East Asian and Pacific affairs in the Biden administration.

entry.title: Chinese leader Xi Jinping arrives in U.S. for first state visit in 11 years
entry.summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping arrived in the United States on Wednesday evening for his first state visit in 11 years.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: A judge has temporarily restored White House access for three media outlets barred by Trump, Trump and China's Xi Jinping will meet today, Israel's prime minister to speak at UNGA.

entry.title: Tucker Carlson on the war with Iran and why he worries about the spread of tribalism
entry.summary: For NPR's Newsmakers, Steve Inskeep asks Tucker Carlson about the war in Iran, President Trump and tribalism.

entry.title: Just one month after her death, a feud is brewing over Dolly Parton's estate
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with New York Times reporter Emily Cochrane about a feud that has erupted over Dolly Parton's estate.

entry.title: Farmers face big expenses and an uncertain bottom line during fall harvest season
entry.summary: As the fall harvest gets underway, many farmers are in the red. While crop prices have improved somewhat since last year, operating costs have increased, led by record high diesel prices.

entry.title: New research suggests human actions could be driving increase in disease outbreaks
entry.summary: Infectious disease outbreaks are on the rise worldwide. A new analysis finds human actions, from deforestation to climate change, are partly responsible.

entry.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for assault
entry.summary: More than six years after his first trial began, former movie mogul Harvey Weinstein's New York sex crimes case came to a close Wednesday when he was sentenced to 15 years in prison.

entry.title: 'Nerd Heaven'? George Lucas's new museum opens, but it's not just about 'Star Wars'
entry.summary: George Lucas's new museum opens, but it's not about 'Star Wars'
